[s0l0!-header][h1]Classes[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The focal point of [b]Object Oriented Programming (OOP) [/b]are [b]objects[/b], which are created using [b]classes[/b].
The [b]class [/b]describes what the object will be, but is separate from the object itself. In other words, a class can be described as an object's blueprint, description, or definition.
You can use the same class as a blueprint for creating multiple different objects. 

Classes are created using the keyword [b]class[/b] and an indented block, which contains class [b]methods [/b](which are functions). 
Below is an example of a simple class and its objects.[code format="py" ][b]class [/b]Cat:
  def __init__(self, color, legs):
    self.color = color
    self.legs = legs

felix = [b]Cat[/b]("ginger", 4)
rover = [b]Cat[/b]("dog-colored", 4)
stumpy = [b]Cat[/b]("brown", 3)[/code]
[note]This code defines a class named [b]Cat[/b], which has two attributes: [b]color [/b]and [b]legs[/b].
Then the class is used to create 3 separate objects of that class.
Tap [b]Continue [/b]to learn more![/note]

content.text:
面向对象编程（OOP）的核心是**对象**，它是用**类**(class)创建的。
**类**描述了对象是什么，但与对象本身是不同的。换句话说，一个类描述一个对象的属性、行为。

你可以使用同一个类作为模板来创建多个不同的对象。

类是用关键字**class**和一个缩进的块来定义的，它包含了类的**方法**（也就是函数）。
下面是一个简单的类及其对象的例子。
content.text_html:
The focal point of **Object Oriented Programming (OOP) **are objects, which are created using classes. The **class **describes what the object will be, but is separate from the object itself. In other words, a class can be described as an object's blueprint, description, or definition. You can use the same class as a blueprint for creating multiple different objects.

Classes are created using the keyword class and an indented block, which contains class **methods **(which are functions). Below is an example of a simple class and its objects.

面向对象的编程（OOP）的焦点是对象，它是用类创建的。 类**描述了对象将是什么，但与对象本身是分开的。换句话说，一个类可以被描述为一个对象的蓝图、描述或定义。 你可以使用同一个类作为蓝图来创建多个不同的对象。

类是用关键字class和一个缩进的块来创建的，它包含了类的方法（也就是函数）。 下面是一个简单的类及其对象的例子。

content.content:
# Cat 类
class Cat:
  def __init__(self, color, legs):
    self.color = color   # 属性color
    self.legs = legs     # 属性 legs

# Cat 类的实例化对象
felix = Cat("ginger", 4)
rover = Cat("dog-colored", 4)
stumpy = Cat("brown", 3)

content.text:
这段代码定义了**Cat**类，它有两个属性：颜色**color**和几条腿**legs**。然后，通过该类实例化创建3个独立对象。

点击**继续**，了解更多面向对象编程的知识！

resolved.title: 初始化方法 __init__
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]__init__[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The [b]__init__[/b] method is the most important method in a class. 
This is called when an instance (object) of the class is created, using the class name as a function.

All methods must have [b]self[/b] as their first parameter, although it isn't explicitly passed, Python adds the [b]self[/b] argument to the list for you; you do not need to include it when you call the methods. Within a method definition, [b]self [/b]refers to the instance calling the method.

Instances of a class have [b]attributes[/b], which are pieces of data associated with them.
In this example, [b]Cat[/b] instances have attributes [b]color [/b]and [b]legs[/b]. These can be accessed by putting a [b]dot[/b], and the attribute name after an instance. 
In an [b]__init__[/b] method, [b]self.attribute[/b] can therefore be used to set the initial value of an instance's attributes.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example: [/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="404"]class Cat:
  def __init__([b]self[/b], color, legs):
    [b]self[/b].color = color
    [b]self[/b].legs = legs

felix = Cat("ginger", 4)
print(felix.color)[/code]
[note]In the example above, the [b]__init__[/b] method takes two arguments and assigns them to the object's attributes. The [b]__init__[/b] method is called the class [b]constructor[/b].[/note]

content.text:
`__init__`方法是一个类中最重要的方法。
当类的一个实例化对象被创建时，会被自动调用，并用类名作为函数。

所有方法都必须有**self**作为**第一个**参数，尽管调用是不需要明确地传递，但Python会自动为你添加**self**参数；你在调用方法时不需要包含它。在一个类方法定义中，**self**指的是调用该方法的类对象实例。

类对象实例有**属性**，这些属性是与它们相关的数据变量。
在这个例子中，**Cat**的实例有属性**color**和**legs**。这些可以通过在实例后面加上一个**点**`.`和属性名来访问。

在一个`__init__`方法中，**self.attribute**用来设置属性的初始值。

**例子**:
content.text_html:
The init method is the most important method in a class. This is called when an instance (object) of the class is created, using the class name as a function.

All methods must have self as their first parameter, although it isn't explicitly passed, Python adds the self argument to the list for you; you do not need to include it when you call the methods. Within a method definition, **self **refers to the instance calling the method.

Instances of a class have attributes, which are pieces of data associated with them. In this example, Cat instances have attributes **color **and legs. These can be accessed by putting a dot, and the attribute name after an instance. In an init method, self.attribute can therefore be used to set the initial value of an instance's attributes.

**init**方法是一个类中最重要的方法。 当类的一个实例（对象）被创建时，它被调用，使用类名作为函数。

所有的方法都必须有self作为它们的第一个参数，尽管它没有明确地传递，Python为你添加了self参数；你在调用方法时不需要包含它。在一个方法定义中，**self **指的是调用该方法的实例。

类的实例有属性，这些属性是与它们相关的数据片段。 在这个例子中，猫的实例有属性颜色和腿。这些可以通过在实例后面加上一个点和属性名称来访问。 在一个**init方法中，self.attribute**可以被用来设置一个实例的属性的初始值。

例子。

content.content:
class Cat:
    def __init__(self, color, legs):
        # 初始化函数 设置属性值
        self.color = color
        self.legs = legs

felix = Cat("ginger", 4)

# 输出属性
print(felix.color)

content.text: 在上面的例子中，`__init__`方法有两个参数，并将它们赋值给对象的属性。这个`__init__`方法称为类的**初始化方法**。
content.text_html:
In the example above, the init method takes two arguments and assigns them to the object's attributes. The init method is called the class constructor.

在上面的例子中，**init方法接受两个参数，并将它们分配给对象的属性。这个init方法被称为类的构造器。

Classes can have other [b]methods [/b]defined to add functionality to them. 
Remember, that all methods must have [b]self [/b]as their first parameter.
These methods are accessed using the same [b]dot [/b]syntax as attributes.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="405"]class Dog:
  def __init__(self, name, color):
    self.name = name
    self.color = color

  [b]def bark(self):
    print("Woof!")[/b]

fido = Dog("Fido", "brown")
print(fido.name)

假设你正在编写一个网络游戏!

Complete the code to take the name and level from user input, create a Player object with the corresponding values and call the [b]intro[/b]() method of that object.
